lines.text: Papa ke antim sanskaar mein jo buzurg unke pairon par ro rahe the, kal tak woh mere liye bas ek ajnabi the.
Aaj pata chala, unka naam Shankar hai.
Diary mein unke naam ke neeche Papa ne bas itna likha tha, platform chaar.
Subah station pahuncha, toh platform ke aakhri kone mein ek chhoti si chai ki dukaan thi.
Mujhe dekhte hi woh ruk gaye, aur bole ki meri chaal bilkul Papa jaisi hai.
Phir chhappar ke neeche tange ek hook se ek puraana glass utaara. Kinaara toota hua tha.
Kehne lage ki Papa isi glass mein chai peete the, aur unhone use teis saal se sambhaal kar rakha hai.
Maine unke haath dekhe. Baayein haath mein sirf teen ungliyaan thi. Wahi haath, jo us din Papa ke pairon par the.
Mujhe samajh nahi aa raha tha ki koi ek bus driver ko itna kaise yaad rakh sakta hai.
Diary mein Shankar ji ke naam ke aage chhe hazaar rupaye likhe hain. Saal do hazaar teen.
Ikkis lakh ke aage chhe hazaar kuch bhi nahi, phir bhi ghar bachaane mein har rupaya kaam aayega.
Lekin jis aadmi ne Papa ka ek glass itne saal bacha kar rakha, usse main hisaab kaise maangoon?
